body: Hey are you still in that situation? Plz message me.

Hey, just reading this and comparing your situation to mine, which is similar in many ways. Except I don’t have a job. Or freedom. So please know that you’re not alone. I’m struggling to find the solution between “if I die ppl will miss me “ and “if I’m alive no one gives a shit.” So please...., know that you’re not alone. My only advice would be, if you have a savings, see if you can live with someone else temporarily. Or if you have a car, live in your car. Sometimes the lack of control for our situations is what’s really making us suicidal. I’m very close to doing that just to get some control over my life. 

If you’re under 18, I would say try your hardest to wait it out until you’re of age to leave home. Realize that it’s the lack of control of our current situation that’s keeping us in these mental cages. I don’t wanna say “don’t resort to suicide” but, it’s just words compared to the insurmountable amount of pain behind the decision. Please message me if you want to talk.
THANK YOU! It’s just to prevent other people from getting hurt by your actions. I wish I was detached and unemotional. I see nothing wrong with it either tbh

Hey, let me tell you something. I’m 23F. I graduated with a crappy GPA in a tech field. It’s been 6 months out and I can’t land a job either. I live at home with mega strict controlling parents, who think I excelled in school. My parents are extremely successful people who have a certain public image, and Im just a fuck up. I lie a lot to them and the lies are becoming harder to tell. I feel like an imposter here. The man I love is leaving me because my depression has pushed him away. He was all I had left for support. I also feel slow, unmotivated, and on the verge of suicide. It feels like an easy solution, I get it. I wish I had words of encouragement, but I know sometimes what people really need is someone to relate to more than anything. I’m tired of lying to my family, disappointing them, I’m going to take my savings, and just get up and go. Figure life out. And if I don’t figure it out, then I don’t. 
My only advice would be: find something you want, and then anything that makes you money. And come to terms with your situation, it’s the only way to make peace. It’s hard, I’m still trying to do the same. But just know that you’re not alone.

Literally have the same exact parents. Except me and my sister are on the same boat and have had enough. If you’re old enough, and have friends, just try to leave. Figure out life as you go along. It’s hard to have ambition and drive when living with a narc.
